subject: MerchantBank MAP: SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / Data Retention - readiness checklist and timeline
body:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@merchantbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: pq@finreg.co
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MerchantBank MAP + security queues (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement and security at MerchantBank asked us to map out the required compliance gates before we can sign. I attached our initial MAP (tabbed) and a short list of must-have items:

- SOC 2 report (or at least SOC 2 Type II summary + control mapping)
- Completed SIG/CAIQ responses for core data flows
- Executed DPA with data retention and subprocessors clearly called out
- Clarify retention windows (transactional logs vs. application-level data) and deletion SOPs
- Evidence of encryption-in-transit & at-rest and KMS/provider details

Can you confirm Redwood's timeline for each item and who on your side will own delivery? Procurement has a target close date of 2027-05-10.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Sr. Procurement Manager — MerchantBank
Attachment: MerchantBank-MAP-v0.9.xlsx

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@merchantbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference.com>, pq@finreg.co
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MerchantBank MAP + security queues (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Hi Alice —

Appreciate the clear checklist. I reviewed the MAP you attached and sketched a proposed delivery plan below (high-level). We can meet Procurement's 2027-05-10 close if the following commitments land on schedule.

Redwood proposed MAP (owners & dates):
- SOC 2 summary and control mapping (Redwood Security) — deliver 2027-04-23
- SIG/CAIQ draft responses (Redwood + MerchantBank Q/A) — deliver 2027-04-26
- DPA redlines (Legal + Laura Bennett) — initial redlines 2027-04-20, negotiate to agreement by 2027-05-04
- Data retention table (per data class) & deletion SOP (Product + Karthik owner) — draft 2027-04-22, final by 2027-04-29
- KMS/HSM and encryption details (Security) — 2027-04-21

Owners: Karthik will lead the retention table and technical notes; Laura will own legal/DPA redlines; Redwood Security will handle SOC 2 and SIG responses and coordinate evidence. I'll be the point contact for Procurement.

I've attached our internal artifacts we typically share: SOC2-summary-2026.pdf, SIG-CAIQ-responses-draft.xlsx (the format we prefer to return), and a template DPA redline. If MerchantBank's legal has specific clauses to prioritize (e.g., data subject rights, vendor subprocessors, breach notification timing), flag them and Laura will expedite.

Proposed 30-minute sync tomorrow to align on outstanding asks and confirm signature path. Are you available 2027-04-19 11:00-11:30 PT?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachments: SOC2-summary-2026.pdf; SIG-CAIQ-responses-draft.xlsx; DPA-redlines-MerchantBank.docx

---

From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@merchantbank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: pq@finreg.co
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:59:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MerchantBank MAP + security queues (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention)

Thanks, Marissa — 11:00 PT tomorrow works. A couple of clarifications up front so we can use the sync efficiently:

1) For SOC 2, we need either Redwood's full Type II report or a completed control mapping with signed attestations from your security officer for the controls that touch cardholder or transaction processing. A summary PDF is helpful but may not be sufficient for internal auditors.
2) For retention, MerchantBank has two tiers: 7 years for transaction history (Reg X) and 180 days for session & ephemeral logs; we need explicit deletion/archival SOPs and proof of periodic purge for logs older than 180 days.
3) The DPA must include subprocessors list and a clause allowing MerchantBank audit rights with 30 days' notice. If Redwood has a standard carve that prevents audits, we will need to negotiate.

We shared our legal's initial asks in the MAP (MerchantBank-MAP-v0.9.xlsx). Please have Laura/your legal team prioritize the subprocessor list and audit clause.

See you tomorrow.

—Alice

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@merchantbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.inference.com>, Redwood Security <security@redwood.inference.com>, pq@finreg.co
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MerchantBank MAP + security queues (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention) — sync notes and next steps

Alice / MerchantBank team —

Quick recap from today's 30-minute sync and concrete next actions to keep us on the 2027-05-10 close path. Short bullets for the MAP tracker:

- SOC 2: Redwood Security committed to share the Type II summary and a control mapping by 2027-04-23. If procurement still needs the full report, we'll escalate to provide an auditor contact by 2027-04-25. (Attachment: SOC2-summary-2026.pdf)
- SIG/CAIQ: We'll deliver a filled CAIQ workbook 2027-04-26. MerchantBank to mark any high-priority follow-ups in-column; Redwood will return answers or evidence links within 48 hours of those marks. (Attachment: SIG-CAIQ-responses-draft.xlsx)
- DPA: Laura to send first-pass redlines 2027-04-20. Key negotiation items flagged: audit clause timing, subprocessors disclosure cadence, and retention obligations. (Attachment: DPA-redlines-MerchantBank.docx)
- Data retention: Karthik to provide a per-data-class retention table + deletion SOPs on 2027-04-22. Will include concrete purge scripts/process and the list of storage locations (S3 buckets, audit logs, etc.). (Attachment: data-retention-table.csv)
- Subprocessors: Redwood provided an initial list during the call (AWS, CloudEdge Analytics, LogStore Inc.). Laura will follow up with the complete legal-validated list on 2027-04-20.
- Next sync: 2027-04-26 10:00 PT to validate SIG answers and confirm final DPA posture.

Open risks/escrows: If MerchantBank requires the full SOC 2 report with auditor statements and if auditor refuses to provide a copy, this may push the close >2027-05-10. We'll surface escalation paths (SOC contact / PoR).

Please confirm acceptance of the timeline or list any blockers by EOD 2027-04-21 so we can re-plan.

Thanks everyone —
Marissa
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachment stub list: MerchantBank-MAP-v0.9.xlsx; SIG-CAIQ-responses-draft.xlsx; SOC2-summary-2026.pdf; DPA-redlines-MerchantBank.docx; data-retention-table.csv
